howe_sound.label: Howe Sound
howe_sound.text: >Marine Forecast Issued 04:00 PM PDT 15 August 2026 Tonight and Sunday. Strong wind warning in effect. Wind southerly inflow 5 to 15 knots except southwesterly inflow 20 to 25 over northern sections. Wind becoming northerly outflow 10 to 15 near midnight then becoming southerly inflow 5 to 15 near noon Sunday except southwesterly inflow 15 to 20 over northern sections. Showers ending this evening with a risk of thunderstorms. Showers Sunday late in the day with a risk of thunderstorms.
